title: Fog of war: per-cell per-player visibility with server-side terrain generation
description: Support exploration-style games where terrain is generated server-side and revealed as players explore. Two sub-features:
design: Pre-allocated large grid, per-cell per-player visibility bitmask, server holds full map, vision range computed from unit positions. No truly dynamic grid resize needed.
close_reason: Fog of war implemented: per-cell per-player visibility (unexplored/visible/fogged), vision range, Manhattan distance computation, cell-level filtering in filter_for_viewer. Both Rust and Python engines.
